headline: From PGP to Mythos: a brief history of export controls that didn't stop anyone
snapshot: For the last 30 years, stopping the flow of cybersecurity-related software has proven to be ineffective. It's unclear why it would work now with Anthropic's cybersecurity model Mythos. The competitive question is whether this changes the model race, enterprise integrations or customer lock-in as major AI providers battle for durable platform advantage.
